keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «맥스가 집에서 멀어져 무서워한다(문제)» 와 «냄새를 따라 집까지 간다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Max is far from home and scared) and the solution (he follows the smell home). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Max, a small brown puppy, and his family
Max runs after a ball and gets far from home.
He follows the smell of dinner all the way home.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: and gets far from home. He feels
. He follows the smell all the way

words: One day, he runs after a red ball.
a round toy you can throw
Soon he is far from home, and he feels scared.
It is the smell of his family's dinner!
Max follows the smell all the way home.
His family hugs him, and Max is happy again.
to hold someone close with your arms

evs: Soon he is far from home, and he feels scared.
Max is a small brown puppy.
His family hugs him, and Max is happy again.
why: 맥스는 집에서 멀어져서 무서워해요. «far from home» 이 그 이유예요.
Max feels scared because he is far from home.

qs.q: "Max follows the smell all the way home." What does "all the way" mean?
qs.qko: «all the way home» 에서 «all the way» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: the whole way, until he gets home
evs: Max follows the smell all the way home.
One day, he runs after a red ball.
It is the smell of his family's dinner!
His family hugs him, and Max is happy again.
why: «all the way» 는 «끝까지 쭉» 이라는 뜻이에요. 맥스는 집에 닿을 때까지 냄새를 따라가요.
"All the way" means the whole way. Max follows the smell until he gets home.

qs.q: How does Max find his way home?
opts: He follows the smell of dinner.
evs: It is the smell of his family's dinner!
Max follows the smell all the way home.
One day, he runs after a red ball.
Max is a small brown puppy.
why: 저녁밥 냄새가 났고, 맥스는 그 냄새를 따라 집에 갔어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
He smells his family's dinner, and he follows that smell home. You need both sentences.

ends: Max plays in the yard with his family.
Max meets a new friend at the park.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>Max is smart</u> because <u>he follows the smell home</u>.”
